mnaw:factions/oculus_task_prompt: Listen to the witches as they gossip.
mnaw.gossip.spell_hint: Mmm, %s... You know, %s, the sisters have been whispering about %s lately. Such fascinating magic, don't you think?
mnaw.gossip.ritual_hint: Ah, %s... I can sense it, %s. You're ready to dive deeper into our secrets.
mnaw.gossip.coven_lore.1: Ah, the scent of %s... It reminds me of the old days, when the Coven was strong.
mnaw.gossip.coven_lore.2: *sniff* %s... The ancient witches used to brew the most powerful potions with such herbs.
mnaw.gossip.coven_lore.3: That %s smell... Did you know the first witch discovered magic through flowers like these?
mnaw.gossip.coven_lore.4: Oh, %s! My grandmother told me the Coven's secrets are written in the language of flowers.
mnaw.gossip.coven_lore.5: The fragrance of %s... It carries memories of moonlit rituals and sisterly bonds.
mnaw.gossip.coven_lore.6: Mmm, %s... We sisters share everything, you know. Pain, joy, even magic... through our little dolls.
mnaw.gossip.faction.1: I smell %s... Those Council fools think they understand magic, but they know nothing of true power!
mnaw.gossip.faction.2: %s, how lovely... Unlike those Fey creatures who prance about thinking they're so special.
mnaw.gossip.faction.3: Ah, %s... At least you're not one of those demon-consorting warlocks. Such unsavory company!
mnaw.gossip.faction.4: The scent of %s... Better than the stench of decay those Undead carry with them everywhere.
mnaw.gossip.general.1: *sniff sniff* Is that %s I smell? How delightful!
mnaw.gossip.general.2: Oh my, %s! I haven't smelled that in ages!
mnaw.gossip.general.3: The scent of %s always makes me nostalgic...
mnaw.gossip.general.4: %s... Such a lovely fragrance. You have good taste!
mnaw.gossip.general.5: Mmm, %s... I should gather some for my potions!
